title: payment-api: high latency runbook
content: Symptoms: p95 latency above 800ms. Check the database connection pool (max 50), then the downstream fraud-check dependency. Mitigation: scale payment-api to 6 replicas and enable the fraud-check circuit breaker. Open a SEV-2 incident if customer-facing checkout errors exceed 2%.

title: payment-api: 5xx error spike
content: If the 5xx rate exceeds 5% for 5 minutes, roll back the last deployment with `deployctl rollback payment-api`. Page the payments on-call. Severity: high when checkout is blocked.

title: auth-service: login failures
content: Most login failures come from expired signing keys. Verify the JWKS endpoint and rotate keys with `authctl rotate-keys`. If all logins fail, treat as critical.

title: order-service: queue backlog
content: Consumer lag above 10k messages indicates stuck consumers. Restart the consumer group, then check for poison messages in the dead-letter topic. Backlog without customer impact is low severity.

title: inventory-db: replication lag
content: Replication lag above 30s causes stale stock counts. Pause heavy batch jobs, check replica disk IO. Promote a new replica if lag keeps growing for 15 minutes.

title: notification-service: email delays
content: Email delays are usually SMTP provider throttling. Check provider status page and switch to the secondary provider in the config flag `notify.smtp.secondary=true`. Low severity unless OTP emails are affected.

title: Incident severity guidelines
content: critical: full outage or data loss. high: major feature broken for many users. medium: degraded performance or partial impact. low: minor issue with workaround. Always search for a runbook before opening an incident and include the service status in the description.

title: On-call escalation policy
content: Page primary on-call for high and critical incidents. Escalate to the secondary after 15 minutes without acknowledgement. Medium and low incidents go to the team queue.

title: search-service: degraded relevance
content: Poor search relevance after a deploy usually means the index alias points to a partial index. Re-point the alias to the last complete index with `searchctl alias --latest-complete`.

title: General health check procedure
content: 1) Check service status dashboard. 2) Compare error rate and latency to the 7-day baseline. 3) Check recent deployments. 4) Search the knowledge base for a service-specific runbook.
